# S-PAY

> S-PAY (by Zawadi Technologies LLC) is a money super app for remote workers and global businesses. Users get a digital US-dollar wallet, a real US bank account number and EU IBAN, instant peer-to-peer transfers, and local cash-outs to M-Pesa, mobile money, PIX, SEPA and bank accounts. It also runs a free remote jobs board. Built on the Celo network.

## Product

- [Home](https://spayewallet.com/): Overview of the S-PAY wallet, virtual bank accounts, and local cash-outs.
- [How it works](https://spayewallet.com/how-it-works): Step-by-step guide to receiving, holding, and cashing out money with S-PAY.
- [For Business](https://spayewallet.com/#business): Business accounts, KYB verification, and batch payroll for companies and marketplaces.
- [Remote Jobs](https://spayewallet.com/jobs): Free board of fully remote jobs, updated daily across engineering, design, marketing, finance and more.

- [Create a free account](https://spayewallet.com/register): Sign up with email or Google in under two minutes.

## Notes

- Banking and payout services are provided through licensed partners; S-PAY screens transactions for AML and sanctions compliance and requires identity verification (KYC/KYB).
- Areas behind sign-in (dashboard, wallet, banking, card, profile, admin) are not crawlable and require authentication.
